title: LTX: expose end-frame-only conditioning, sharing the H3 frame-role button
description:
PART OF THE MPI-4 LTX TRACK, with MPI-520 (v2v extend). All three touch the same LTX workflow/op wiring - sequence them behind MPI-4 rather than picking this up alone.

LTXVAddGuide takes an arbitrary frame_idx (the shipped ltx_i2v.json uses 0 for first, -1 for last), so LTX can condition on ANY frame - but the workflow gates on two explicit booleans, Input_Text_to_video and Input_Use_End_Image, and the FLF path ALWAYS includes the First guide. There is therefore no way to reach end-frame-only even though the model supports it. Surfaced 2026-08-06 while adding the same capability to MiniMax H3 under MPI-449. Ship the same UI: when the prompt box holds exactly ONE image chip, a button picks whether it is the start or the end frame. Adopt the H3 pattern of deriving mode from WHICH images are present rather than adding a third boolean, so illegal states become unreachable instead of merely discouraged.
acceptance: ltx_i2v.json and its fp8/mxfp8/stage2 siblings can reach end-frame-only: the Last AddGuide at frame_idx -1 runs WITHOUT the First guide
A real end-frame-only LTX generation is run and judged - structurally valid is NOT proof it looks good at guide strength 0.7, since these models are trained mostly on first-frame conditioning
The single-chip start/end button is SHARED with H3, not reimplemented
Mode is derived from which images are present, not from a new user boolean
If end-only looks bad, the finding is written down and the card closes rejected rather than shipping it
